import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-778b7494.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The full-length 2 stripe is the boundary; move the non-background shape
    # toward it, leaving a full 8 stripe directly behind the moved shape.
    rowline = next((r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])), None)
    if rowline is not None:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2,4)]
        if not pts: return out
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
        cols = [c for r,c in pts]
        widthcols = (min(cols), max(cols))
        nrlo, nrhi = ((rowline+1, rowline+1+hi-lo) if lo > rowline else (rowline-(hi-lo)-1, rowline-1))
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c] = 4
        # Preserve shape under translation along stripe normal.
        dr = nrlo-lo
        for r,c in pts: out[r+dr][c] = grid[r][c]
        behind = nrhi+1 if lo > rowline else nrlo-1
        if 0 <= behind < h:
            out[behind] = [8]*w
        return out
    colline = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if colline is not None:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2,4)]
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
        nc = colline+1 if lo > colline else colline-(hi-lo)-1
        dc = nc-lo
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c] = 4
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c+dc] = grid[r][c]
        behind = nc+(hi-lo)+1 if lo > colline else nc-1
        if 0 <= behind < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][behind] = 8
        return out
    return out
'''
p.write_text(s)
exec(compile(s,str(p),'exec'))
g=[[4]*6 for _ in range(15)];g[5][0:2]=[9,9];g[9]=[2]*6
print(transform(g))
